$$ f_X(x) = \frac{\theta 2^{\theta}}{x^{\theta+1}} \mathbf{1}_[2, +\infty) (x) 
$$

## (a) Find a complete sufficient statistic ##

**Solution**: 

$$ S = \sum_i \ln X_i \text{ is complete and sufficient by the prop of full rank exponential family} 
$$ 

## (b) Find MLE $\hat{\theta}$ ##

**Solution**: 

$$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{(1)} \qquad &
\ell(\theta)
= n \ln \theta
+ n\theta \ln 2
- (\theta + 1)\sum_i \ln x_i
\\[1em]

\text{(2)} \qquad &
\frac{\partial \ell(\theta)}{\partial \theta} = 0
\quad \implies \quad
{\color{red}
\boxed{
\color{white}
\hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{MLE}}
=
\frac{n}{\sum_i \ln(X_i/2)}
}}
\end{aligned}
$$
